subject: a-pr
title: A.PR.------PROG.CONT.
description: Chart 2 of 3 on book p. 439 (TRF(CW)-11). A-PR (all-purpose) is the subject; PROG-CONT (progressional continuance) is the partner. From the subject: IF-SPT (infra-spirituality), VT-DY (vibrational dynamics) and TR (transformation). From IF-SPT: PROJ-DY (projectional dynamics) and MOT-DY. From VT-DY: RT-DY (reality dynamics). From RT-DY: REL-APC (relevant application) and SOC-RT-P (social reality particulars). From SOC-RT-P: OBS (observation). From TR: INFO-TRNS (information transference). From INFO-TRNS: LK-IMP (linkage implications) and HI-P (high purpose).
